subject: reasoning
question: Six family members P, Q, R, S, T, and U are seated at a circular table facing each other. S is to the immediate left of U, and Q is second to the left of S. P is second to the left of R. Who is the immediate neighbour of both U and P?
solution:
Given: **Six family members P, Q, R, S, T, and U are seated facing each other.**

1) S is to the immediate left of U, and

2) Q is second to the left of S. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/63f9352a334f634e9238b4cf5a37294a8021dec659d044db23645a9e28b0687d.png] 

3) P is second to the left of R.

&l
t;img alt="" src="https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c9a6a6941d5d0987422a774872fe09fe69aa7f9f2009e85b79a913f90182b161.png" style="width: 222px; height: 226px;" />

So, T is the immediate neighbour of both P and U.

Hence, the correct answer is, **"Option 4".**
